description: Sales credited to campaign creators for commission. action read (default): each sale (store, order, amount, refunds, commission or why it is not counted, how it was credited) and each creator's code and tracking link. Shopify orders and Stripe charges are read from the brand's connected store twice a day: a sale is the creator's when it used their code, or their link was on the last visit before it within the campaign's windowDays; commission is payable lockDays after the sale, and a refund lowers it (one already paid is taken back from the creator's next payouts, never their bank). action sync reads the store now. action record (participantId, amountUsd, ref, at) adds a sale from a store Hermoso does not read, e.g. WooCommerce; action adjust (key, amountUsd) lowers a recorded one after a refund. action set_code (participantId, code) sets a creator's code to match one made in the store. Free.
